metadata.description: Personal collection of GitHub Copilot agent plugins by krprashantpk.

plugins.name: code-shift
plugins.description: Guided, any-direction migration of repositories, pull/merge requests, branch policies, pipelines, and issues across Azure DevOps, GitHub, and GitLab. Read-only dry-run first, migrates only the resource types you select, and confirms every destructive action. No PATs.

plugins.name: code-story
plugins.description: CodeStory turns backlog ideas into implemented, verified code through three focused stages: author the story, build a file-by-file technical plan, and execute the approved plan.
